Class UpdateFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.messages.updateMessages.UpdateFactory
public class UpdateFactory extends Object
Centralizes the construction of all UpdateMessage DTOs. Takes data directly from model objects and extracts only what the client needs
